access_evidence: probe semanticscholar_paper_get: HTTP 200 with externalIds incl. PubMed, PubMedCentral, ArXiv, MAG; POST probe semanticscholar_batch_post in POST_CALLS.json: HTTP 200 after one HTTP 429 on the anonymous tier. 60 DOIs in one batch call -> 56 resolved.
blockers: The batch endpoint ignores the field projection unless `fields` is passed as a query parameter; without it the response is HTTP 200 with only {paperId,title} - a silent partial response.
historical_depth: publicationDate only; no creation or update timestamp is exposed, so every record is SNAPSHOT_ONLY.
licence_note: The Graph API is free for research use, and the Open Research Corpus is ODC-BY, but the API terms restrict bulk redistribution and require attribution. Recorded as open_no_explicit_licence because API-level terms rather than a content licence govern reuse of these responses.
name: Semantic Scholar Graph API
notes: Four of 60 DOIs returned null from the batch call (not in S2). Those are recorded as ABSENT, not as errors.
rate_policy: Anonymous tier is shared and does throttle: HTTP 429 observed twice, recovered by bounded exponential backoff. A key exists on request.
what_is_new: The only source here exposing an ArXiv identifier, and it carries PubMed and PubMedCentral ids too, so it is a second independent path to the PMID<->DOI edge: 56/60 anchors, 1 of which OpenAlex and Crossref could not reach by PMID.
